changelog:
v2.7.2 — VAULT HARDENING (PIN-guard everywhere)

You found the bypass holes; they're closed:

🔒 The Freezer now REFUSES to unfreeze vault apps — no more no-PIN back door. Vault apps unlock only in the Vault, with the PIN.
🔒 Unfreeze All and the Freezer Doctor skip vault apps.
🔄 EMPIRE RELOCK PATROL: every time the Empire opens, any vault app that was unlocked by hand (Settings → Apps → Enable) re-freezes automatically. Tampering gains a snooper nothing — locks re-arm themselves.

Why we do NOT offer locking the Settings app: on this phone Shizuku dies on reboot and wireless debugging lives inside Settings — freezing Settings while shell power is down is a true lockout. The patrol covers that tamper path safely instead.
